why_this_file_exists: S9 published a four-member disposition vocabulary on three payloads and claimed the wire shape as operational. It is not: every leaf every production path emits today is MEASURED, because the one component that produces StructuralZero, Withheld and Starved -- survival/outcome_state.OutcomeLedger -- is not the ledger any walk runs with. The serializer supports all four and is unit-tested on all four; no request can reach three of them. That is a real gap between what the commit bodies say and what the tree does, and it is written down as a dated, gated artifact rather than as commit-body prose, because prose is what the next baseline re-capture absorbs (R-16 Shape). -- CLOSED 2026-08-14: the entry is in retired[] with its gate inverted rather than deleted, so the gap, the block that held it and the ruling that released it stay readable together.
how_an_entry_closes: An entry moves from defects[] to retired[] only when the contradiction is resolved in the tree, and only together with its gate test's own inversion: the reproducer stops reproducing and the test asserts the resolved property instead. Deleting an entry is not closing it.

retired.raised_by: the R-35 verifier for slice group S9, confirmed by the remediation lane before its first src/ edit, and re-raised unchanged by the second R-35 pass on 2026-08-13
retired.what: No dispositions entry on any payload the calculator serves is anything but MEASURED. The record that produces the other three, survival.outcome_state.OutcomeLedger, is now the receipt walk's companion and is filled by every real fight -- so the write-once rule and D-62's uniqueness are enforced over production numbers -- but no view reads its quantities onto a leaf, so the three other dispositions still reach no payload.
retired.why: LeafBlock.put has exactly one caller -- measured -- which constructs Measured(amount=float(value)). The receipt view publishes a refused row's outcome fields through that same call: a transition the walk refused writes damage/applied_amount/overkill as a MEASURED 0.0 and carries its skipped_reason beside them as a raw string, which is a declared zero wearing a measured zero's entry. AttackerOutcome and ObjectiveFold still carry plain floats, so a disposition would not survive the projection even where a view asked for one.
what_is_nevertheless_true: The wire shape is real and complete: serialize_leaf emits all four, a WITHHELD leaf is absent with its receipt-bearing entry present, and static/js/app.js renders that case as a named refusal with live call sites (tests/test_program_views.py).

Every published number on all four payload surfaces carries exactly one entry, both directions, asserted against live runs: /api/calculate's whole response (987 leaves across its two maps, 3999a96), its combat receipt, /api/bis and /api/optimize (tests/test_payload_dispositions.py).

Quantity.__add__ propagates dispositions through a sum and Tagged.__add__ propagates the view tag, both unit-tested over the member matrix.  Since 3a1bf82 the view-tag half also has production callers -- the BIS objective folds its score through ranked_total out of Tagged parts whose tags come from the payload's own map, and the two ranking surfaces refuse a previewed block on the way in.  That half of the earlier 'a type nothing on the serving path uses' finding is closed.

What remains unclosed is only the disposition half: every value flowing through the algebra in production is Measured, because the record that produces the other three is not the record any walk runs on.
retired.why_this_lane_may_not_fix_it: The remaining half is blocked on an adjudication ruling rather than on effort: every one of its 38 qualifying occurrences is a text_change that R-19 sends to an oracle, and R-18's export cannot brief an oracle on a question about the campaign's own disposition vocabulary. Landing it anyway would mean either re-capturing a baseline over 38 unanswered qualifying occurrences, which R-19's last sentence forbids, or filing 38 receipts on a question no investigator was given the evidence to answer, which is the oracle shopping the R-15/R-18 amendment made unwritable.
retired.for_the_phase_owner: Either S10 schedules the ledger join and the fold retyping, or the phase records that criterion 19's end-to-end backstop is discharged by fixture alone and says so in the umbrella. An implementation lane may not choose which.
retired.reproducer: Run a live coupled receipt (scripts/golden_snapshot.coupled_entry on any combat-carrying scenario) and collect the disposition of every entry in combat['dispositions']: the set is exactly {'MEASURED'}, including on the 24 rows whose skipped_reason says the walk refused them.
retired.reproducer_after_closure: Inverted: at least one production payload carries an entry whose disposition is not MEASURED -- specifically, a refused row's outcome fields carry STRUCTURAL_ZERO with the walk's own refusal as the reason.

re_raised.by: the R-35 verifier for slice group campaign-close
re_raised.finding: Umbrella criterion 1's production clause and criterion 8's one-APPLIED-per-key clause both rest on OutcomeLedger, which had no construction site in src/, so neither ranged over a real fight.
re_raised.what_the_remediation_lane_did: Closed criterion 8's clause outright by joining the ledger to the receipt walk, and reduced criterion 1's to the emission half with the block named exactly and the footprint measured.

what_closed_and_when.by: the remediation lane for slice group campaign-close, answering the R-35 verifier that reported umbrella criteria 1 and 8 NOT DISCHARGED
closed: The construction-site half. survival/receipt_state.ReceiptLedger builds an OutcomeLedger and drives it from write, annotate and skip, so an AST scan for OutcomeLedger construction expressions over src/calculator names a production site and every /api/calculate request fills one.

D-62's uniqueness now fires over real fights rather than over fixtures: measured on the five committed coupled scenarios, ten ledgers record 314 slots, claim 290 applied contributions with 0 unidentified, and observe 24 refusals -- the same 24 rows the committed coupled baseline publishes with a skipped_reason.

Two defects the join surfaced, each landed as its own commit: _WRITE_ALIASES mapped the diagnostic live_damage onto the applied outcome field, and the kernel's trigger arm overwrote an already-stamped refusal reason with the consequence that followed from it.
what_closed_and_when.gate_inversion: test_the_outcome_ledger_is_the_receipt_walks_companion replaces test_the_outcome_ledger_is_constructed_nowhere_but_its_own_module and asserts the resolved property instead of the reproducer.

what_closed_and_when_the_emission_half_c.by: the remediation lane for slice group campaign-close, on the ruling the campaign owed itself
what_closed_and_when_the_emission_half_c.what_unblocked_it: The umbrella's Amendment E of 2026-08-14 -- a disposition transition is adjudicated by citation, not by verdict, under three guards, the third being that the leaf the entry describes may not move. Before it, all 76 occurrences were text_change transitions R-19 sent to an investigator R-18's export could not brief, and the slice had no legal landing. The block this entry named was adjudication, and adjudication is what moved.
what_closed_and_when_the_emission_half_c.the_change: program/views/receipt.py publishes the three panels' outcome fields through survival.outcome_state.outcome_quantity, so a transition the walk refused carries StructuralZero with the walk's own refusal as the reason instead of a Measured zero with the refusal one key away as a bare string.
what_closed_and_when_the_emission_half_c.the_published_numbers_did_not_move: StructuralZero.read() is 0.0 and the branch is only reached on a zero. Measured: 76 differing leaves against the committed coupled baseline, every one of them an entry of the dispositions map; zero numeric leaves; the pair baseline reads 'snapshot identical'; scripts/golden_coupled_exact.json reproduces every per-attacker total unchanged.
what_closed_and_when_the_emission_half_c.landed_as: one commit against the committed baselines plus docs/receipts/expected-golden-diff-campaign-close-dispositions.json (R-17), which enumerates all 76 paths, both sides of each, and the leaf each entry describes with the value it holds on both sides.
what_closed_and_when_the_emission_half_c.gate_inversion: test_a_refused_row_publishes_a_declared_zero replaces test_every_published_disposition_is_measured and asserts the resolved property: every refusal-zeroed outcome field on a refused row is STRUCTURAL_ZERO carrying that row's own skipped_reason, and a priced row's is still MEASURED.
what_closed_and_when_the_emission_half_c.what_is_still_not_claimed: AttackerOutcome and ObjectiveFold still carry plain floats, and WITHHELD and STARVED still reach no production leaf of the receipt view. This entry was about the emission of a non-MEASURED disposition by a production path, and that is what closed; the fold retyping is named here so nobody reads this closure as more than it is.

retired.reproducer_now: Inverted, and it is the entry's own reproducer_after_closure: run a live coupled receipt on cleaver_bloodsong_roster and collect the disposition of every entry in combat['dispositions']. The set is {'MEASURED', 'STRUCTURAL_ZERO'}, and every one of the 38 outcome leaves on the 24 rows carrying a skipped_reason is STRUCTURAL_ZERO with that row's refusal as its reason.
